mangal.note: Mangal (kuja) dosha is checked from both the lagna and the chandra rashi; the 2nd-house inclusion in the dosha-bhava set follows the South-Indian convention (some traditions omit it). Both charts indicate Mangala in a kuja-dosha bhava — classically considered mutually neutralised.

convention: North-Indian ashtakoota, whole-sign vashya, no cancellation rules (v1)
disclaimer: Computed from the classical ashtakoota (36-guna) system for study and cultural reference — not advice on any relationship or marriage. Conventions vary by region and school; a qualified astrologer weighs far more than a score.
